resources.string: No Play Services. Token grants LAN control of the host queue.
Pick media, stage it under Download/HandForge, then run FFmpeg via Termux (pkg install ffmpeg) or a bundled libffmpeg.so. Remote desktop control remains on the Connect screen.
FFmpeg backend: Termux ($PREFIX/bin/ffmpeg). Enable allow-external-apps=true in ~/.termux/termux.properties and grant RUN_COMMAND.
No FFmpeg backend. Install Termux + `pkg install ffmpeg`, or ship libffmpeg.so under jniLibs.
Input selected — ready to stage and encode.
